title: Queue + backpressure for compact-card writes (L32)
description: ADR-054. Wires ADR-024 compact-card writes through ADR-014 queue+backpressure.

invariants.name: soft_70pct_telemetry_only
invariants.description: Soft threshold = telemetry, no behavior change.

invariants.name: non_blocking_producer
invariants.description: Card writer never blocks request path.
must: queue.put is non-blocking (returns drop indicator on full)

invariants.name: raw_magma_authoritative
invariants.description: Queue full -> cards dropped, raw events still written.
must: raw MAGMA append never gated by queue
compact cards are derived layer per ADR-011/015

invariants.name: backpressure_metrics
invariants.description: Queue depth + drop_count emitted to events.jsonl.
